items.text: – Ọ bụ nkume mabụr. Mabụr pụtara na ọ dị oke ọnụahịa.
items.q: A boy is meant to mispronounce 'marble' and think it means expensive. Is 'mabụr' a natural child's slip of 'mabụl', still recognizable?
before: Anyị gara n'ihu ọzọ. N'etiti ụzọ ahụ, otu ụlọ dị. Mgbidi ya mara mma. Ghassem na-asị mgbe niile:
